plugins.name: lastmile
plugins.description: The last mile is the work. A gate that runs before reporting completion, deferring anything, or opening a branch, issue or merge request: did I run the artifact, did I claim a rule nothing enforces, am I filing adjacent finished work instead of doing it. Composes with blastradius (how much process) and ponytail (how much to build).
